about_the_game:
Hijack Jump – Your Community is the Final Boss.

Fight your way up a gigantic, unforgiving parkour tower filled with traps, cannons, and brutal obstacles. But the real danger isn’t the course — it’s your chat. Viewers can join your session anytime, hijack your run, and actively try to shoot you down. No limits, no mercy: your community plays against you and turns every attempt into pure chaos.

Don’t want to suffer alone? Play co-op with up to 8 players — with friends or fellow creators. Climb together, reach checkpoints, celebrate every jump… while your chat does everything to send you back down.

Streamer vs. Community. Friends vs. Chaos. How far can you make it?

Parkour

Take on a towering, complex parkour course that spans different themes and areas. Rolling pillars, firing cannons, and countless obstacles are waiting to make your life miserable. If that's not enough, there’s still Hardcore Mode, without any save points. But trust us - that’s not all!

Hijack

This is where everything escalates. You think you can just focus on your own run? Think again. Anyone can join your session and open fire on you. Giant balls, saxophones — whatever they use, the outcome is always unpredictable. And now imagine 100 hijackers targeting you at the same time… pretty tricky, right?

This doesn’t happen passively in chat: hijackers are live inside the game, aiming and shooting in real time to knock you out of your run.

Co-op

Not everything has to be a solo struggle. In co-op mode, you and your friends can team up to conquer the course together. Work as a team to overcome obstacles, reach savepoints, and celebrate every hard-earned jump side by side. Of course, hijackers can still crash the party – so stick together if you want to survive the chaos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-6300 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB) / AMD Radeon R7 370 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
